snippet.title: Compound Interest: Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The networks are dead. The city has fallen. Manage your crew and send them into danger to earn money and respect. Claim turf, control trade, and make allies or enemies as you reshape the fully simulated city of New Sterling.
Demo on Steam now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4343910/Compound_Interest/
